QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] Vain Hunt
QuestInfo.1: The frozen weapons are up to no good! Go to #b#m241000211##k and defeat #b250 #o8630004##k enemies. Then go to #m241000220# and talk to #p2230000#.

0.0: Hey, you. Yes, I'm talking to you. You were the kid who wanted to get into the castle, right? I got a small favor to ask. You wanna hear me out? I'll reward you. What do you say?

yes.0: You're not half bad. I want you to eliminate the frozen weapons that spawn around here, just like last time. Their nasty blue energy and sharp edges give me goosebumps. \r\n
yes.1: Now go get rid of #b250 #o8630004##k monsters in #b#m241000211##k.\r\n#r(Caution! This quest will reset at midnight on Sunday.)#k

no.0: You afraid of a challenge? Fine! Be that way!

1.0: You really got rid of 250 of them? You're pretty good at this. Take this, you earned it.

yes.0: I'll have more work for you from time to time. Come find me when you're free.

default.0: I don't think you got #b250 #o8630004# monsters#k yet. Go hunt them down in #b#m241000211##k!
